correctness.rationale: Over all 4^4 words, unbordered words are exactly 180. Reverse-complement closure yields 56 internally compatible involution orbits, with 12 singleton and 44 paired. The 56-vertex orbit-compatibility graph has 540 edges. An exhaustive include/exclude weighted-clique recurrence over all candidates has 398 distinct memoized states and yields max cardinality 17, with 32 optimal labeled unions. An independent reconstruction enumerated all 32, checked 5 self-reverse-complements and 6 paired orbits each and four orbits under the eight complement-preserving alphabet permutations. The reduction from codes to cliques is bijective, so this is an exhaustive finite proof, not a partial sample.
residual_risks: Finite checks establish only their stated finite domains; infinite conclusions depend on analytic argument.
